request.state: Granite Finch requires two independent reviewers unless the change is documentation-only. The release note calls patch P-7 “documentation cleanup,” but the diff summary says it changes a timeout constant from 30 to 45 seconds and fixes three comments. Classification follows changed behavior, not the release-note title. Reviewer A approved. Reviewer B wrote, “I would approve after the timeout test passes.” The test passed later, but Reviewer B never sent a new approval; conditional intentions are not approvals.

criteria.blocked_failed_test: Blocked because the required timeout test failed.
criteria.blocked_second_review: Blocked because a behavioral change lacks a second approval.
criteria.ready_one_review: Ready because only one review is required.
criteria.ready_two_reviews: Ready because two valid approvals exist.
